name: typeorm
description: TypeScript & JavaScript ORM for Node.js — supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, and more.

issues.title: Migration generation drops and creates columns instead of altering resulting in data loss
findOne with relations does two queries.
Using .save for one-to-many relationship always tries to insert instead of update.

discussions.title: It is so anoying timestamp to order migrations files.
why use NEWSEQUENTIALID() rather than NEWID() in sqlserver?
Unit-test gaps in OrmUtils boundaries, ConnectionOptionsReader, and the codemod CLI
v1 removed the CustomRepository* error classes — agents still catch them
Thank you maintainers! + Holu framework integration
Built a small kernel that catches a TS↔SQL inconsistency case

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: release SQL Server query locks after subscriber errors by @IbrahimHafez1 in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12939
* ci: unblock releases and skip the sonar scan on dependabot pull requests by @michaelbromley in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12948
* chore(deps): bump SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action from 8.2.2 to 8.3.0 in the github-actions-third-party group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12947
* fix(mssql): place table lock hint inside nested join parentheses by @lazerg in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12765
* fix(persistence): honour the utc flag when detecting changed date columns by @maxymlyskov in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12949
* fix: do not load lazy relations when building the entity id map by @lazerg in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12985
* docs: document the simple-enum column type by @SssiiiSssii1 in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12981
* perf: use performance.now() for query execution timing by @pri12ya871 in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12750
* fix: release database cache runners after failed removals by @IbrahimHafez1 in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12938
* fix(query-builder): guard nulls in orderBy object shorthand by @tsushanth in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12706
* docs: note Appwrite managed PostgreSQL on Postgres driver page by @abnegate in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12859
* fix: use static require calls in PlatformTools.load for bundler compatibility by @h4sht in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12729
* ci: fail on the Sonar quality gate only for pull requests by @michaelbromley in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/13053
* chore: prepare release 1.1.3 by @alumni in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/13056

## New Contributors
* @maxymlyskov made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12949
* @SssiiiSssii1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12981
* @pri12ya871 made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12750
* @tsushanth made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12706
* @abnegate made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12859
* @h4sht made their first contribution in https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/12729

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/compare/1.1.2...1.1.3
